# cmdlib command simulator (vendored)

The files in this folder are the command runtime of cmdlib, a browser
datapack IDE by Gameboy612: https://github.com/Gameboy612/cmdlib

- Upstream: `src/lib/mc/` (without its tests) and `src/lib/ids.ts`, at commit
  `d905375` (2026-11-03).
- Its LICENSE file says "All rights reserved", which the author says was
  generated by mistake; they gave MMS permission to use the code. Until
  upstream publishes a license, MMS treats it as MIT (text below).

Local changes, so a future update can carry them over:

- `import type` on type-only imports, for `verbatimModuleSyntax`.
- `ids.ts` moved in next to the rest, and `datapack.ts` imports it as `./ids`.
- `nbtPath.ts` `applyPathModify`: `append`, `prepend` and `insert` on a
  missing tag create an empty list first, as the game does. MMS's generated
  call stacks (`data modify storage <ns>:mms stack append value {}`) rely on it.
